# Inline browser turn presentation

Retained as PR evidence for the correction following #4826 and #4660.
These controlled captures show the production UI at 390 and 1440 pixels,
in light and dark themes, plus preview off and compact completed states.
The page frame is a PNG captured from a local fixture dashboard and delivered
through the shared binary frame protocol. It is not a real Station Chromium
producer, external provider, native-device, deployment or replay recording.

The exact source, capture hashes, command and lifecycle limits are recorded in
[captures.json](captures.json). Retain while the PR uses these stable image links.
